launch_entry_type.description: The entry type for launches (products, releases, shows).

launch_date.description: The date field that holds the launch date. Publish the entry before that date as the announcement. Any post date already past is skipped.

post_at.description: The time of day the posts are drafted, in your workspace's time zone, for example `09:00`.

draft_entry_type.description: The entry type the drafts are made as.

draft_body_field.description: The text field of that type.
